scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names "backend,frontend" --prefix-colors "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml down -v && docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --wait
